messages.text: Your product is being found (81% retrieval) but rejected during comparison...
我的背包明明很舒適，你們的分析有問題

Possibly — but that's exactly the problem. In 120 simulations your product was recommended in only 12% of comfort-driven queries. The engine isn't judging whether the bag IS comfortable; it can only use what the page says, and the page says nothing: no back panel construction, no strap padding spec, no hip belt, no long-wear reviews. Sample rejection reason, verbatim: 'no information available about back support or long-wear comfort'. Meanwhile the Osprey page specifies an AirScape mesh back panel and load-bearing hipbelt. An AI cannot recommend an advantage it cannot see.
其實我們有 ventilated back panel 跟加厚肩帶，只是頁面沒寫

Then that is the fix, not a disagreement. If the ventilated back panel and padded straps are real, putting them on the page should directly move your comfort-cluster share. I can create a v2 of your product page with those claims added and re-run the 24 comfort intents. Run it?
